primary_saturation_guard.quantity: all-small-mammal occupied capture trap-nights / observed active trap-nights within the exact-3-night plot-event

primary_abundance_predictor.name: genus-level event MNKA
primary_abundance_predictor.known_alive_rule: known alive at complete standard exact-3-night plot-events between first and last target capture at that plot

taxonomic_rule.response_taxon: published target taxon concept remains the W/B response grouping

primary_abundance_predictor.ecological_interpretation: density of congeners experienced by the focal taxon concept within the plot-event
primary_abundance_predictor.precedent: O'Fallon et al. 2025 used genus-level Peromyscus MNKA because species identifications were unreliable

secondary_abundance_sensitivity: unique tagged individuals of the same genus observed in the event per active trap-night
taxon-concept-specific MNKA only as a prespecified sensitivity where taxonomic history is stable
model-based closed/SCR density only under a separate pre-effect contract
no_rescue_rules: do not switch from genus MNKA to a more favorable abundance proxy after W/B slopes are viewed
do not include cross-genus tag histories
do not raise the 0.30 saturation cutoff
do not redefine the temporal bout
